about: Guest RAM layout of the USA StarCraft 64 cartridge as read by experiments/ares-headless/capture.cpp ('tap tick rec' writes tap.bin). Addresses are KSEG0; multi-byte values are big-endian. Each field is proven (validated by a controlled change or a cross-check in a tracked audit), candidate (read in retained states, never validated by a controlled change) or unknown. tools/parity_decode.py refuses to build a gating check from a field that is not proven. Changing an offset or a status needs a new evidence line; a new layout gets a new version.

tick_counter.evidence: S1-S3 (docs/audits/2026-11-25-parity-capture-spikes.md): advances once per game tick, also in text boxes and the pause menu; never skipped in 58,215 reads

pause_halfword.evidence: S2: 1 through both T1 opening text boxes and the pause menu; unit timers frozen exactly while it is set (355 of 355 ticks)

seconds.evidence: S2: floor(unpaused ticks / 16) over 58,213 ticks when read on the follow-up step

selector.evidence: S2: 4 in a fresh campaign mission; 4 -> 6 when the Game Speed slider moved

clock.record_rule: A tick's record is the read one step after the counter changes to it (S3: the change-step read is torn about 1.3% of the time). Unpaused ticks count ticks whose change-step read shows a zero pause halfword.

unit_table.locator: one heap block: u32 size word 0x448E0 (900 x 312) then three 0xBABEFACE guard words; rows follow; exactly one match or no table (menus)
unit_table.evidence: Nov 17 and Nov 19 census states (T10, Z1, Z8, skirmish); S1-S3: found in every in-mission read, links never bad or asymmetric in 116,437 reads
unit_table.live_rule: a row is live only while its sprite pointer (+0x0C) is nonzero; free rows keep stale bytes

prev.evidence: S3 link checks: every link is zero or a row start and symmetric

hp.evidence: field map (docs/audits/2026-11-26-parity-field-map.md), T3 opening: a Zergling's integer part fell 35 -> 29 on the tick a Marine Gauss Rifle bullet (6 damage) appeared on it, and 35 -> 15 when a Vulture grenade (20 damage) reached its target

sprite.evidence: liveness rule; census counts matched Z8 placed rows exactly

x.evidence: census: placed buildings at their CHK source x; S4 move captures: Marines move toward the ordered point

owner.evidence: census: placed rows by CHK owner; skirmish human stuck at 4 workers

order.evidence: field map (docs/audits/2026-11-26-parity-field-map.md): five T1 Marines under tape commands read 3 idle, 6 after Move, 2 for one tick on arrival then 3, 2 then 3 after Stop, 107 after Hold, 14 after B attack-move, in two fresh captures; the PC orders.dat numbering

order_state.evidence: field map: 0 when an order is issued, 1 from the next tick for Move, Hold and attack-move (PC orderState); not tied to a named state

resource_amount.evidence: field map: equals the CHK resource amount of every placed mineral field and geyser at all 30 campaign launches; in the T3 opening the mined fields fell by exactly 8 at each of 177 trips while minerals_gathered rose 173 times (four loads still carried at the end)

shields.evidence: one read-only scan of retained states (design review); gated by type

type.evidence: census type ids matched CHK placements; S2 Marine row (type 0)

energy.evidence: one read-only scan; gated by type

build_timer.evidence: S2: Marine timer counted 360 -> 0 over 360 unpaused ticks, frozen while paused

research_timer.evidence: field map, T3 opening: the computer Hatchery's row read 1,200 (techdata.dat Burrowing research time) on the tick its order became 75 and the bank fell 100/100, counted down one per tick, and the researched flag was set when it ran out (then 0xFFFF)

research_tech.evidence: field map, T3 opening: 44 (no tech) on idle buildings; 11 (Burrowing) for exactly the research above

research_upgrade.evidence: field map, P1 opening: 61 (no upgrade) on idle buildings; 26 (Pneumatized Carapace) on the computer Lair while its order read 76 and research_timer counted down from about 2,000, until upgrade_level turned 1

status.evidence: S2: bit 31 clear while the Marine trained, set when complete

globals.about: tap.bin carries these bytes in guest order on every tapped read; owner index k is the k-th u32 of each array (12 players).

minerals.evidence: S4 Blood Bath captures: rises by 8 at each human worker delivery while nothing is spent, together with minerals_gathered

gas.evidence: census and static reading; no gas mined in S4

minerals_gathered.evidence: S4 Blood Bath captures: cumulative, +8 per delivery, never decreases; equals the bank rise while nothing is spent

rng.evidence: seed, draw count and state words named by static reading; not validated against a launch

orders.about: Values of unit.order (+0x4D). Only values seen under a controlled command are proven; the numbering is the PC orders.dat one, which every proven value follows.

2.name: Guard
2.evidence: one tick after a Move arrives and after Stop, then 3

3.name: PlayerGuard
3.evidence: idle human Marines and SCVs at launch; after every finished command

6.name: Move
6.evidence: C-Right then A on open ground, from the next tick

14.name: AttackMove
14.evidence: B then A on open ground

75.name: ResearchTech
75.evidence: the T3 computer Hatchery for exactly the ticks of its Burrowing research; not commanded

76.name: Upgrade
76.evidence: the P1 computer Lair during its Pneumatized Carapace upgrade; not commanded

156.name: ComputerAI
156.evidence: every computer-owned unit in the T1 and Z1 launches; never commanded

pools.about: Heap blocks: a u32 size word, three 0xBABEFACE guards, then the records. Sprites and images are allocated from the top of their pools. Addresses are those of the campaign launch tapes (tools/parity field-map tapes); the decoder locates a block by its size word.

fields.draw_head: 0x1C u32 (candidate: the primary image until the unit is selected, then a selection-circle image from another pool)

sprite.evidence: field map: every live unit's +0x0C points into this pool; sprite x/y equal the unit's x/y on every tick of the T1 field capture; image pointers lead to the unit's images

image.evidence: field map: image_id is the images.dat row of the unit (Marine 239, SCV 247, Zergling 54, shadows 240/248/55); iscript_header equals the iscript.bin header offset of that row's script id for every image read; while a Marine walks, iscript_offset steps through the ROM's Walking loop 7 bytes a tick, animation reads 11 (Walking), frame_set_x4 is 4 x the last playfram argument and the frame index follows the direction (12 moving south-east, 8 east); idle, wait counts down by one a tick from the ROM's wait argument

bullet.evidence: field map, T3 opening (per-tick pool): every live row's weapon is its source unit's units.dat weapon (Marine 0, Vulture 4, SCV harvest 14), its flingy is that weapon's weapons.dat flingy and its owner the source's owner; a Gauss Rifle row appears on its target, which loses 6 hit points that tick; a grenade row moves from the Vulture toward its target about 7 px a tick with time_remaining counting down, and the target loses 20 hit points when it arrives

fog_tiles.locator: the heap block of width x height x 4 bytes (CHK DIM) whose masks pass the subset rule

fields.explored_mask: 0x02 u8 (bit p clear: player p has explored the tile)
fields.visible_mask: 0x03 u8 (bit p clear: player p sees the tile)

fog_tiles.evidence: field map: in T1 (64 x 64, block at 0x80274520 on the launch tape) the human's visible tiles grow along the path of five moving Marines tick by tick and are dropped only at refreshes about 100 frames apart; a visible tile is never unexplored; computer player 4's bits clear only around the Zerglings

player_tables.about: Per-player arrays, 12 players, one byte per entry, player-major; Brood War sizes (61 upgrades, 44 techs).

upgrade_max.evidence: field map: equals the CHK's effective PUPx maximum levels for all 12 players at every campaign launch (cross-check, no change seen)

upgrade_level.evidence: field map: equals the CHK's effective PUPx start levels at every campaign launch, including missions that start players at levels 1-3; in the P1 opening player 0's Pneumatized Carapace entry turned 1 on the tick the Lair's upgrade finished

upgrade_in_progress.type: bits[12][64] (8 bytes a player, bit u of byte u / 8, low bit first)
upgrade_in_progress.evidence: field map, P1 opening: player 0's bit 26 was set while the Lair upgraded Pneumatized Carapace and cleared when upgrade_level rose; bit 24 set when the next upgrade started

tech_available.evidence: field map: equals the CHK's effective PTEx availability at every campaign launch (cross-check)

tech_researched.evidence: field map: equals the CHK's PTEx researched settings at every launch, and in the T3 opening player 4's Burrowing entry turned 1 on the tick the Hatchery's research timer ran out

tech_in_progress.type: bits[12][48] (6 bytes a player, bit t of byte t / 8, low bit first)
tech_in_progress.evidence: field map, T3 opening: player 4's bit 11 set on the tick the Burrowing research started and cleared when it finished

dat_tables.about: The gameplay .dat tables the cartridge runs on: resident big-endian column arrays, each column starting on a 4-byte boundary in file order. tools/sc64_parity_fieldmap.py tables DUMP compares them with the BOLT tables the ROM carries.
dat_tables.weapons.label: 0x800CD3BC
dat_tables.evidence: field map: in T1 RAM 104 of 107 columns equal the BOLT tables byte for byte at these addresses; units.acquire_range (44 rows), units.right_click (6 buildings) and techdata.unknown (Brood War rows) differ; see the audit for the per-mission comparison

human_player: resolved per scenario (see tools/sc64_parity_metrics.py SCENARIOS): T1 = the owner of the Marines and SCVs; Blood Bath = the owner of the human race's workers when the computer plays another race
